legend: Gaz is an infinite city. The streets of this city are as follows :
The streets of this city can be introduced on the two-dimensional coordinate system as follows :
A horizontal street coinciding with the x−%%ZSMJ0%%axis.
A vertical street coinciding with the y−%%ZSMJ1%%axis.
For every natural number n%%ZSMJ2%%, there is a circular street with radius n%%ZSMJ3%% with the center of (0,0)%%ZSMJ4%% coordinate.

We know that Alice is currently at a junction with coordinate (x1,y1)%%ZSMJ5%% and Bob is currently at a junction with coordinate (x2,y2)%%ZSMJ6%%. A junction is a point at intersection of two streets. For example, (0,1)%%ZSMJ7%% and (0,−1)%%ZSMJ8%% are junctions formed from intersection of horizontal street and circular streets with radius 1%%ZSMJ9%%.
Alice wants to know the shortest distance that she has to walk in the streets of Gaz to reach Bob.
input: In the first line of input you'll be given a number t%%ZSMJ10%% −%%ZSMJ11%% the number of the testcases.
In each of the next t%%ZSMJ13%% lines, you'll receive 4%%ZSMJ14%% integers x1,y1,x2,y2%%ZSMJ15%% which show the coordinates of the junctions where Alice and Bob are located.
It is guaranteed that at least one of x1,y1%%ZSMJ17%% and at least one of x2,y2%%ZSMJ18%% will be 0%%ZSMJ19%%.
output: For each test, print only one line containing a single floating-point number −%%ZSMJ20%% the minimum answer. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6%%ZSMJ21%%.
